svg.title: DAE evaluation: held-out digits images
svg.desc: Each row shows the noisy input, model reconstruction, and clean target for the same original image. The first four evaluation entries are shown without selecting for visual quality. These are scikit-learn 8×8 digits images, not MNIST.
